# Velair 1.7.0-beta.1

Velair 1.7.0-beta.1 adds explicit handling for climate changes made outside
Velair, a local Diagnostics workspace, and an independent Room Assist deadband.

## ✨ Added

- Managed climates can now detect external HVAC mode and setpoint changes. The
  default **Keep automatic** policy reapplies the current Velair intent, while
  optional policies can enter **Manual adjustment** until the next schedule
  block, for a configured duration, or until automatic control is resumed.
  Overview, services, automation events, Today's timeline, and Diagnostics all
  expose the same per-climate control state.
- Added a read-only Diagnostics workspace with scheduler and per-climate health,
  bounded in-memory runtime history, configurable event categories, privacy-safe
  support reports, a global Diagnostics status sensor, and
  `diagnostic_issue_changed` automation events.
- Room Assist now has its own per-climate deadband, independently configurable
  from Adaptive Preconditioning. It uses native Celsius or Fahrenheit defaults
  and limits, preserves the previous effective value during migration, and
  refreshes active assistance immediately after being saved. Its live
  visualization marks the no-correction zone with a dynamic hatched band and
  updates its limits and legend from the saved value. On narrow screens, the
  compact legend follows only the visible part of the zone while scrolling.

## 🚀 Improved

- Profile validation and operational notices now remain readable when several
  messages occur together, with responsive stacking, accessible announcements,
  and restrained transitions.
- Diagnostics reports replace climate and associated sensor entity IDs with
  stable aliases by default. Retaining the original IDs requires an explicit
  temporary choice for each export, while Profile, Mode, and pause identifiers
  remain redacted.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed the active Boost animation extending outside its timeline block after
  resizing the panel or using a narrow screen.

## 🧭 Notes

- This is a beta release intended for real-world testing before Velair 1.7.0.
  Feedback on external adjustments, Manual adjustment return policies, Room
  Assist deadband behavior, and Diagnostics reports is especially useful.
- External-change attribution depends on the managed climate integration
  reporting sufficient Home Assistant context and state detail. Integrations
  that discard that information may not distinguish every delayed device update
  from an adjustment made outside Velair.
- Existing installations keep automatic Velair authority by default, preserving
  the behavior from earlier versions unless a different external-adjustment
  policy is selected.
- Update through HACS when possible, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the
  browser or companion app after installing the beta.
